description.text: Two Champion's Leagues were held in 2007, the last year. Champion's League Spring 2007, in Tokyo on 13 May, was for the 27 division winners of Battle Road Spring 2007; Champion's League Summer 2007, on 9 September, was a round robin for the 24 winners of Battle Road Summer 2007. The top four of each division, the Elite Four, won the redrawn Champion's League card, Ryo Ueda's art with Dialga and Palkia, in a trophy shield in the spring and a plaque in the summer, and the summer's grand champions were invited to the 2008 World Championships.
